purpose: Retrieve one recorded employee run under its deployment, the same run under the other owned isolated deployment, and a generated negative-test run ID: three read-only requests with expectations fixed before execution.
rules: Cases are independent read-only requests; a case-specific result (including a timeout, 403, not-found, fixture or service error) does not stop later cases.
Stop the campaign on a failed local pre-request check (checksum, CLI version, command allowlist or target match) or rejected authentication (401).
Stop when the authorization window ends or the request budget is exhausted.
An interrupted or timed-out request is recorded as uncertain and never replayed.
